innovation_summary: Bounded rack-placement planner for Colossus-class GPU fleets: it takes validated node and rack declarations, sorts by descending requested kW then stable node id, applies first-fit-decreasing placement with preferred-rack handling and fallback, and returns explicit rack usage, headroom, and per-node unplaced reasons without mutating caller objects or any external system. It is the strongest-evidenced repo in this slice: a monolith promotion receipt records 20 passing planner and truth-surface tests at an exact source head with a hashed CI artifact. Overstated claims (100k+ GPU operation, live topology discovery, GPU telemetry, 99.9% availability) were explicitly removed from the public surface rather than defended.
